synopsis.en: A vampire hunter fights to save a besieged city from an army of otherworldly beasts controlled by Dracula himself.
synopsis.zh: 贝尔蒙特和赛法尔在一个藏有邪恶秘密的村庄里安顿下来。阿鲁卡多为一对仰慕者提供指导。艾萨克开始寻找赫克托的下落。

characters_bangumi.name_native: ラルフ・Ｃ・ベルモンド
サイファ・ヴェルナンデス

intro.logline: 战争结束了，仇恨却没有——四条故事线在灰烬上各自滋长。
intro.synopsis:
德古拉已死，瓦拉几亚却没有迎来和平。特雷弗与西法一路清剿残余魔物，流浪到林登菲尔德——一座表面虔诚、处处透着诡异的小镇，镇上的修道院里藏着某个正在成形的阴谋。

另外三条线同时展开：阿鲁卡多独守空城，迎来两位慕名而来的日本吸血鬼猎人；艾萨克带着他的军团横跨大陆，一步步从复仇者变成别的什么；被押往斯蒂里亚的赫克托，则落入了卡蜜拉姐妹会最危险的一张网——丽诺尔的温柔里。

这是全剧最黑暗、也最「权力的游戏」的一季：没有绝对的主角光环，所有人都在为自己相信的东西付出代价。

characters.role: 战后继续清剿魔物的猎人
characters.motivation: 弄明白林登菲尔德到底哪里不对劲

characters.name: Sypha Belnades
characters.motivation: 同上——而且她通常比特雷弗先看出问题

characters.name: Alucard
characters.motivation: 在孤独中重新学习与「人」相处

characters.name: Isaac
characters.motivation: 找到赫克托，完成他对「人性」的清算

characters.name: Hector
characters.motivation: 在囚禁中寻找活路——戒心却一点点瓦解

characters.name: Lenore
characters.role: 卡蜜拉姐妹会的外交官
characters.motivation: 用温柔手腕把赫克托变成姐妹会的棋子

characters.name: Saint Germain
characters.role: 来到林登菲尔德查探的学者
characters.motivation: 穷尽一生寻找迷失在「无尽回廊」中的爱人

characters.role: 慕名而来的日本吸血鬼猎人
characters.motivation: 学成屠龙之术，解放被吸血鬼统治的故乡

highlights: 口碑最分裂也最黑暗的一季：四线并行的后战争群像剧
丽诺尔与赫克托的博弈是教科书级的心理操控
E9三线同时引爆：地狱开门、背叛之夜、枕边魔戒（8.9分）
本季埋的每一颗雷，都在第四季精准引爆
intro.standing: 第三季把格局从「讨伐魔王」拉成「后战争群像」，争议与赞誉并存；但正是这一季对人性的狠辣刻画，撑起了终季的情感重量——看懂它，才看得懂第四季。

synopsis.en: In Wallachia in 1455, a young woman named Lisa who wishes to be a doctor seeks out Vlad Dracula Tepes, a vampire with advanced scientific knowledge. Intrigued by her courage and ambition, Dracula agrees to teach her, while she in turn offers to help him reconnect with humanity. The two eventually fall in love and marry. Twenty years later (1475), in the town of Târgoviște, Lisa is burned at the stake after a bishop discovers scientific equipment in her home and accuses her of witchcraft. Devastated after learning of Lisa's death, Dracula declares to the people that they have one year to make their peace, after which every human in Wallachia will die by his hand. His son Adrian tells him to go after the man responsible instead of all of humanity, but Dracula refuses to listen and attacks him. One year later, the archbishop hosts a celebration in defiance of Dracula. As promised, Dracula kills the archbishop, destroys the church and orders his army of demonic Night Creatures to kill every person left in Wallachia. As the army spreads across the land, the people place the blame on the kingdom's noble families, including the Belmonts.
synopsis.zh: 阿鲁卡多适应着他孤独的新生活。贝尔蒙特和赛法尔造访一个阴森怪异的小镇。卡米拉带了一个战利品回家。

episodes.title_cn: 祝福你们死去的幼小心灵

notes.summary: 战后数周：特雷弗与西法流浪到诡异的林登菲尔德镇，热情的法官接待了他们，镇上修道院的僧侣却行迹可疑；学者圣日耳曼也来到镇上查探。孤独的阿鲁卡多开始对着木偶自言自语；卡蜜拉押着赫克托回到斯蒂里亚，与她的姐妹会会合。

new.name: The Judge
new.note: 林登菲尔德的掌权者，热情好客背后另有面目

new.name: Sala
new.note: 修道院僧侣首领，总在遮掩什么

new.name: Saint Germain
new.note: 追查修道院的神秘学者

new.name: Lenore
new.note: 姐妹会的外交官，全剧最危险的一张软刀子

synopsis.en: Following an altercation at a pub, Trevor Belmont seeks food and respite in the city of Gresit, which has been besieged by Dracula's forces every night. As he passes through town, he learns that the townspeople blame a group of nomadic scholars known as the Speakers for Dracula's assault. He saves their Elder from a pair of corrupt priests, who brings him back to the Speakers' home. Trevor insists they leave the city for their own safety, but the Elder refuses, as his grandchild has gone missing after venturing into the catacombs below the city in search of the "sleeping soldier", a legendary hero who they believe can defeat Dracula. Begrudgingly, Trevor agrees to retrieve the missing grandchild.
synopsis.zh: 艾萨克在寻找赫克托的过程中得到了意想不到的帮助。同时，卡米拉计划圈占一片土地，而阿鲁卡多遇到了两个追随他的人。

notes.summary: 艾萨克在旅途中意外得到一位店主的善意相助，获赠能定位赫克托的魔镜。卡蜜拉向姐妹会抛出领土扩张的宏图。两位日本吸血鬼猎人——苏米与塔卡登门拜访阿鲁卡多，恳求他传授猎魔之术。

new.name: Sumi
new.note: 日本吸血鬼猎人，阿鲁卡多的学徒

new.name: Taka
new.note: 苏米的同伴，同样拜师阿鲁卡多

synopsis.en: Exploring the catacombs, Trevor realizes that they have been unusually constructed and contain devices matching old family descriptions of devices within Dracula's castle. Finding a stone statue in the visage of a Speaker, Trevor is attacked by a giant cyclops. He defeats the creature, releasing its curse, and rescues the Elder's grandchild, Sypha Belnades. After returning Sypha to her grandfather, Trevor is summoned to the church by the local bishop, the same bishop who ordered Lisa's execution. He orders Trevor to leave Gresit before sundown, as the priests plan to lead a mob to kill the Speakers, offering to spare Trevor and restore his family name in exchange. With the Speakers refusing to retreat, Trevor has them hidden in the cyclops' chamber and takes on the priests leading the mob before escaping into the city.
synopsis.zh: 贝尔蒙特和赛法尔计划离开林登费尔德，但遇到了障碍。艾萨克和船长争论人类的优点。赫克托试图了解丽诺尔。

notes.summary: 特雷弗与西法本想离开林登菲尔德，却被圣日耳曼拖进修道院的谜团。艾萨克在船上与船长激辩人性的善恶；赫克托试图揣摩前来探视他的丽诺尔，却完全不是对手。

new.name: The Captain
new.note: 与艾萨克辩论人性的开明船长

synopsis.en: Night falls as Dracula's army descends upon Gresit. Night Creatures invade the church as it has become so full of corruption that God's presence is no longer felt there. The creatures taunt the bishop by calling out his hypocrisy and false authority before killing him. While Trevor continues his escape, Sypha appears to aid him, revealing herself as a powerful magic user. Trevor exposes the clergy's actions as the true reason for Dracula's invasion and assists the people in mounting a defense against the demons. During the battle, the floor crumbles beneath Trevor and Sypha and they fall deep into the submerged catacombs of the city. Making their way in deeper, they find the "sleeping soldier", revealed to be Adrian, who has spent a year healing from his last fight with Dracula. Adrian, now going by Alucard, engages Trevor in battle, but after seeing his and Sypha's resolve, he relents. Alucard reveals that the myth of the "sleeping soldier" was actually from the future and foretold his meeting with Belmont and Sypha, and that he was testing their abilities. The three prepare to challenge Dracula and end the conflict for good.
synopsis.zh: 泉和隆向阿鲁卡多讲述了他们的过去。圣日耳曼进入修道院，而艾萨克在热那亚受到冷遇。

notes.summary: 苏米与塔卡向阿鲁卡多讲述过去：她们曾是日本吸血鬼女王蝶的俘虏，立誓学成后返乡屠龙。圣日耳曼设法进入了戒备森严的修道院；艾萨克抵达热那亚，遭到城卫队的冰冷「迎接」。

synopsis.en: A flashback depicts Lisa's home in Lupu being raided by the Bishop and his men while Dracula is away, resulting in her arrest to be tried before an inquisition. In the present, Dracula assembles his war council, made up of vampire overlords from across the world, and places human necromancers Hector and Isaac in charge of the war on humanity. The Norse vampire Godbrand objects, believing they should rely on vampires instead of humans for leadership, but Dracula believes Hector and Isaac's hatred of their own kind (Hector being an unwanted child and Isaac being an abused former slave) makes them more trustworthy. As Gresit rebuilds after the battle, Sypha and Trevor see off the other Speakers while Alucard comes to terms with the decision to kill his father. At the castle, Godbrand laments to Hector that their war is fought with no strategy other than wanton destruction. Hector implies that Dracula wants all humans dead no matter the methods used, to Godbrand's disappointment. Dracula teleports the castle to a different location.
synopsis.zh: 贝尔蒙特和法官发现了一个不祥的符号。圣日耳曼的寻宝行动被打断。阿鲁卡多与泉和隆的关系日益密切。

notes.summary: 特雷弗与法官发现了意味不祥的炼金符号；圣日耳曼在修道院内的寻宝之旅意外中断；阿鲁卡多与两位学徒日渐亲密，倾囊相授。

synopsis.en: Trevor and Sypha reunite with Alucard and ask how to locate Dracula's castle when it can move from place to place. Trevor recommends revisiting his old family estate, as the hold beneath the ruins contains information on the castle and tools for monster-hunting. The vampire mistress Carmilla arrives at the castle and causes further discord among the council by criticizing Dracula's approach and inquiring why he did not turn Lisa into a vampire. While traveling to the Belmont estate, Trevor's party is attacked by Dracula's forces; the group slays all the attackers, save one injured demon who escapes. At the castle, Isaac reminisces on his past, having killed his previous abusive master in a moment that shaped his ideals. Godbrand brings Isaac the injured demon, now dead, to extract information from it with his necromancy. At another assembly, the generals argue whether to continue their attack on Argeș or move the siege towards Brăila at Carmilla's suggestion. Isaac informs everyone of his findings, believing Alucard is working with a Belmont. Carmilla urges Dracula to keep watch on the Belmont estate, believing it may contain something that could destroy them.
synopsis.zh: 丽诺尔继续与赫克托相处，渐渐赢得了他的信任。圣日耳曼经历了一场生动逼真、有关无限回廊的噩梦。

notes.summary: 丽诺尔持续经营赫克托的信任，向他描绘「美好梦境」般的未来蓝图。圣日耳曼的噩梦揭示了他的执念：挚爱之人迷失在「无尽回廊」中，他穷尽半生只为寻回她。

synopsis.en: Carmilla tries to convince Hector to create creatures to send to the Belmont house while encouraging Dracula to select Brăila as their next target. Hector reminisces on how Dracula found him in the east of Rhodes and recruited him to raise an army, though Hector asked for a cull of humans rather than a cruel genocide. Trevor, Sypha and Alucard reach the ruins of the Belmont estate and open a sealed door leading to a massive underground library. Sypha begins researching and Trevor locates several monster-hunting weapons, including the Morning Star whip, while Alucard is left uneasy by the various vampire remains preserved there. Godbrand expresses dissatisfaction with Dracula's plan, believing vampires will be left hungry without human blood to consume, but Dracula rebukes him. Carmilla tells Godbrand that Dracula must take the castle to Brăila, revealing how she killed the vampire who sired her after he became old and mad, deeming Dracula has become the same.
synopsis.zh: 圣日耳曼有了令人不安的发现。艾萨克准备迎接一场对决。同时，贝尔蒙特和赛法尔咄咄逼人地质问一名僧侣。

notes.summary: 圣日耳曼在修道院深处发现了令人不安的秘密；特雷弗与西法对萨拉和尚动了粗，仍一无所获。艾萨克率着在热那亚铸造的夜魔大军拔营启程。

synopsis.en: Godbrand comes to agree with Carmilla that Dracula is not fit to lead and that something must be done to change his plans. At the Belmont library, Trevor discovers a magical mirror which allows them to see things far away, and he bonds with Sypha. Carmilla continues to try to recruit Hector, intending to unseat Dracula if the castle is moved to Brăila. In a flashback, Isaac recalls how Dracula saved his life and recruited him to create his army. Godbrand and the other vampire generals grow tired of living without human blood and set out on demonic horses to a nearby village, slaughtering the people. Dracula speaks to Isaac about the war hall's turning against him and confesses he lied to Hector about his intent to spare a few humans. Godbrand privately approaches Isaac and suggests that they should pursue the war without Dracula. Isaac kills Godbrand for his treasonous intentions.
synopsis.zh: 修道院的地下室关着一个活物，对于贝尔蒙特和赛法尔来说，时间至关重要。丽诺尔向赫克托坦白了卡米拉的计划。

notes.summary: 修道院地下室里锁着一头活着的巨大夜魔——僧侣们的图谋昭然若揭。丽诺尔向赫克托揭开卡蜜拉计划的真相：不是征服，而是把人类圈养为食粮。

synopsis.en: Isaac releases Godbrand's ashes from the castle rooftop while Carmilla commands her troops to assemble at Brăila. Hector convinces Isaac to agree to the attack on Brăila. Hector shares this with Carmilla and informs her that his night creatures have nearly reached the Belmont estate. Isaac discusses Hector's request with Dracula, but asserts that there is no betrayal to be concerned about. Dracula reminisces about a time when he savored killing humans, but admits he is tired and cares only for results instead of the details. Carmilla and Hector approach Dracula and he approves the attack on Brăila. Afterwards, Carmilla turns on Hector, explaining he is now implicated in her impending betrayal of Dracula and cannot turn back on her plan now. At the Belmont library, Sypha discovers an unfinished locking spell that could be used to trap the castle in one place. The library starts to shake as Hector's night creatures arrive and attempt to break in.
synopsis.zh: 夜幕下的林登费尔德爆发一场大混乱。艾萨克与魔法师见面，赫克托做出承诺，泉和隆采取行动。

notes.summary: 夜幕降临林登菲尔德，萨拉的教团以全镇性命为祭品撕开地狱之门。艾萨克攻陷魔术师的塔楼；苏米与塔卡在缠绵之际对阿鲁卡多痛下杀手，双双毙命；丽诺尔在枕边将魔戒套上赫克托的手指。

new.name: The Magician
new.note: 奴役一城人的魔术师，被艾萨克击杀

synopsis.en: Trevor fights off the demons as Alucard uses the distance mirror to locate Dracula's castle so Sypha can attempt to complete the locking spell. Dracula moves the castle to Brăila, and most of the vampire generals lead troops across the bridge to attack the town. At Carmilla's behest, Hector reanimates the Bishop and makes him bless the river. Carmilla's troops reveal themselves and bring down the bridge, dropping many of Dracula's soldiers to be destroyed by the now-holy water. Dracula's remaining forces retreat to the castle whilst Carmilla's soldiers cross the river on makeshift bridges. The two armies begin to battle in the castle's main hall, while Carmilla and Hector move elsewhere. Sypha finishes the spell just as Trevor defeats the last of the demons, her struggle against the castle's mechanisms causing the castle to teleport within Brăila, landing in the river and killing most of the two vampire factions. Sypha succeeds, disabling the castle's mechanisms while relocating it above the Belmont library.
synopsis.zh: 地狱之门打开，拉尔夫和赛法尔不得不迎接一场猛烈的进攻。同时，法官留下了令人不安的遗物，而赫克托知晓了自己的命运。

notes.summary: 回廊洞开，特雷弗与西法死战魔潮；圣日耳曼追着爱人的身影踏入回廊，消失其中。法官的「遗产」曝光——镇上失踪的孩子都死于他手，特雷弗亲手处决了他。赫克托得知自己铸的军团已归姐妹会所有；阿鲁卡多将苏米与塔卡的尸体钉在城堡门前——越来越像他的父亲。

route.why: 四线并行铺雷：小镇谜团、城堡学徒、艾萨克远征、斯蒂里亚囚笼——本季所有引爆点都在这四集装药

route.title: 各线暗流
paragraphs: 林登菲尔德：特雷弗与法官发现了意味不祥的炼金符号，镇上僧侣的嫌疑越来越重；圣日耳曼设法深入修道院寻找某样东西，却在里面撞见了超乎预期的状况，寻宝被迫中断。
斯蒂里亚：丽诺尔的「友好攻势」继续奏效，赫克托的戒备一点点松动。城堡：阿鲁卡多与苏米、塔卡日渐亲密，开始倾囊相授——空荡的城堡里久违地有了生气。

route.why: 慢燃加压段：丽诺尔的心理战、圣日耳曼的执念、修道院地下室的真相——看懂这三集才接得住后面的引爆
三线同时引爆的双高潮（8.9分）：本季所有伏笔一次结清，也是第四季的总开关
